sloka: ततः प्रहर्षमगमद्विपुलं पर्वतोत्तमः ।देवतानां पतिं दृष्ट्वा परितुष्टं शतक्रतुम् ॥५-१-१४३॥
transliteration: tataḥ praharṣamagamadvipulaṁ parvatottamaḥ ।devatānāṁ patiṁ dṛṣṭvā parituṣṭaṁ śatakratum ॥5-1-143॥

translations.english: Thereafter Mainaka, the great mountain was delighted to see Indra, lord of the gods, performer of a hundred yajnas satisfied.
